sources.entry: PufferPanel - Game server management panel designed for both small networks and game server providers. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Go

summary.one_liner: PufferPanel is a web-based game server management panel for running and managing multiple game servers from one central location.
summary.what_it_does: PufferPanel is a web-based Game Server Management System that lets you manage several different game servers from a single interface. Server owners can give other users their own servers or grant them access to existing ones. The README says it provides an easy-to-use interface aimed at individual users up to large networks. The README points to external documentation for installation, updating, and management guides, and does not detail specific game integrations or technical features. The project also has a Discord community for help and contributions.
use_cases: manage multiple game servers from one dashboard
give players or users access to their own game servers
run a game server hosting business with user accounts
control game servers through a web interface
how_to_run: Follow the installation guide linked from the PufferPanel documentation
notable: Central web interface for managing multiple game servers
Per-user server access so others can control assigned servers
Free and open source under Apache-2.0
caveats: README gives no detailed feature list or supported game list; it defers to external documentation for installation
Installation steps are not included in the README itself
